column1: # FoldX 5.1 -- licensed. Free academic licence from https://foldxsuite.crg.es/
# Download the LINUX X86_64 build. The copy the lab already has is Mac arm64
# and will not run on CoreHPC; the same licence covers both.
# The binary filename encodes its own expiry date, so yours will not match
# anyone else's. Edit the first row to match your download before installing,
# and edit it again when you renew. chpc-tool doctor foldx runs the binary and
# reads its banner, because an expired FoldX is still present, still
# executable, and only says so when it runs.
# Newer builds ship a molecules/ directory of modified-residue definitions
# INSTEAD of rotabase.txt: the rotamer data is compiled into the binary. The
# rows below are the 2027-01-31 Linux build. If your download ships
# rotabase.txt instead, drop the molecules rows and use a single
# row; tool.conf only warns when rotabase.txt is absent, it does not fail.
# chpc-assets installs FILES, never directories, so each molecule is its own
# row and the destination carries the subdirectory. The molecules are all
# modified nucleotides and none of them is used by protein ddG -- they are
# here so the install matches what the vendor shipped, not because a stage
